Name: Animal Stats
Author: HamBandit
Description:
[center]﻿Animal Stats is a mod that allows you to adjust the stat values of farm animals and the items they produce.

Farm animals can have their Days to Mature, Days to Produce, House Type, Incubation Durstion, Purchase Price, Required Buildings, and Sell Price changed to whatever values you'd like!

Additionally, you can set the sell values of all animal produced items and their corresponding artisan items.

Use [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to make editing the animal stats even easier.

[b]BY DEFAULT, THIS MOD DOES NOT MAKE ANY CHANGES TO ANY ANIMAL STATS![/b]
